provenance.prompt: One polished portrait production reference image on warm ivory, title and FOUR rows of SIX readable studies, consistent size within each row. Row1 FACE VIEWS: Front; Facing left 3/4 nose SCREEN LEFT both eyes; Facing left profile nose LEFT true side; Facing right 3/4 nose SCREEN RIGHT both eyes; Facing right profile nose RIGHT true side; Rear. Row2 EXPRESSIONS: Calm, Curious, Delight, Surprise, Thoughtful, Mild upset. Relaxed brows and natural closed mouths in calm/thoughtful; no constant grin. Row3 FULL BODY VIEWS same six directions, whole ears/tail/quills/feet with margin and contact shadows. Row4 NORMAL POSES as specified. Concise correct labels; no directional headings for expressions. Book warm dimensional illustrated style; preserve exact identity from references; no duplicate limbs or cropped extremities. No extra characters on solo sheet, no invented clothes or aging. This is an established-design reference study, not a redesign. Title Scooby. Reference1 dog beneath Papa and child is authoritative identity and proportions. Brown dog with moderately long floppy ears, curled upward fluffy tail, cream chest/muzzle, dark round nose, attentive expressive brown eyes, sturdy broad body. Preserve original face, ordinary canine muzzle not wolf face, FOUR legs and paws, canine stance, no human standing. Reference2 family style only. Exact age NOT STATED. Row3 all body views show ordinary dog on four paws including front, both opposite 3/4, profiles, back. Row4: Sit, Walk, Lower nose, Wait, Gentle play bow, Lie down. Show tail shape in every full-body view where visible; no riders in solo studies, no saddle/clothes or invented equipment. Gentle varied dog expressions, closed mouth for waiting; do not pant or smile in every cell.

provenance.prompt: Make ONE separate polished portrait relational reference page, SIX large readable panels in 3 rows x 2 columns, clear short labels, warm ivory margins. Keep warm dimensional book illustration, full separate bodies including ears/quills/tails/feet, believable hands/paws contact and weight/support, natural gaze and expressions, no constant exaggerated smiles. No duplicated limbs, merged bodies, wolf faces or new clothing. Use all supplied references directly for identity and relative scale. These are reusable relationship studies, not an unrelated chapter. Title Scooby — Scale & contact. Reference1 canonical dog carrying Papa and PinPin determines LARGE rideable scale: dog's WITHERS near standing Papa's HEAD, broad enough for both hedgehogs seated comfortably. Reference2 published family determines hedgehog identities: Papa adult cool brown quills, Mama adult copper quills, older PinPin child about HALF Papa height, PomPom tiny infant. Do not shrink Scooby to lapdog or make Papa as tall as dog's ears. Six studies: 1 'Same ground scale' full large Scooby standing on FOUR paws beside full standing Papa and smaller PinPin, SAME ground baseline; dog withers level with Papa head, dog's head higher. 2 'Nose to paw' Scooby lowers big nose to child PinPin's extended paw, Papa nearby in grounded guiding stance, full dog not cropped. 3 'Papa and PinPin ride' recreate supported scale from reference1: Papa sits astride broad Scooby with feet either side, child PinPin seated in front, Papa paw supports child's waist, feet separate from dog legs. Dog walks ordinarily on four paws. No saddle. 4 'A gentle side hug' dog lies comfortably on all fours, PinPin sits alongside foreleg hugging dog's shoulder gently, tiny child separate whole body, no merged paws. 5 'Wait with Papa' giant Scooby sits attentive while standing Papa gives clear wait-palm cue, no food, same scale not human-size dog. 6 'Family hello' full large dog lies calmly, adult Mama supports tiny infant PomPom in both arms near dog's lowered attentive nose; child PinPin seated beside Papa looks on. Baby never atop dog or standing. Warm brown dog, cream chest/muzzle, moderately long floppy ears, curly upward fluffy tail, brown expressive eyes, no wolf face. Whole dog visible every panel, believable four-legged anatomy, no extra paws. No age claims.
